# SCI-POINT Author Full-Map-RMS-Method Extract

Identity: `POINT-FULL-MAP-RMS-METHOD v0.1`

State: `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`

This authority is scientifically and lifecycle-distinct from both the
compatibility-fit and formal-error methods. Its absence blocks only the
descriptive dynamic-range product
`fitted_amplitude_over_full_map_rms` and legacy alias `sig2noise`; it does not
block an otherwise authorized fit, displacement, effective-shape product, or
formal error.

The future exact record shall bind:

- exact parent signal role, immutable product, version, and generation;
- exact scientific row population called the full map;
- about-zero RMS versus centered standard deviation;
- center or mean calculation where applicable;
- weighting or no weighting;
- source-region inclusion or exclusion;
- support, validity, and edge state;
- missing/non-finite and zero-denominator behavior;
- units and unit cancellation;
- lifecycle and provenance; and
- identity relation between the RMS parent and fitted amplitude parent.

Until exact bytes are content-bound and owner-approved, no numerical
full-map-RMS, dynamic-range ratio, or significance quantity may be inferred.
The familiar labels `sig2noise` or `peak` do not supply missing scientific
meaning.
